profile.headline: Machine Learning Engineer @ Reddit
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Software Engineer interested in applying machine learning to solve real world problems. Familiar with Python, Spark, AWS and other technologies. Passionate about sharing my knowledge and mentoring others who are interested in pursuing a career in tech. Completed my Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Microbiology & Immunology and Computer Science from the University of British Columbia.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Machine Learning (Recommendations and Discovery)
Software Engineer - Back-end (Notifications Infrastructure)
positions.description:
- Improve, scale and build new features into notifications back-end platform that processes millions of notifications per week
- Helped integrate machine learning models trained using XgBoost into platform to maximize engagement
- Wrote ETL jobs using PySpark to generate new model features or metrics to measure notifications engagement
- Led project to add intelligent push copy selection feature into platform that uses multi-arm bandits to maximize CTR for push campaigns
- Founded & led a monthly newsletter to promote knowledge sharing and highlight contributions of 40+ engineers
- Investigate, identify and debug system issues with the notifications platform when on-call
